joke.en: His harmless joke made the whole class laugh during lunch.
joke.zh: 他無傷大雅的笑話讓全班在午餐時笑了起來。

jolly.en: The jolly guide kept everyone cheerful during the long bus ride.
jolly.zh: 那位開朗的導遊讓大家在漫長車程中保持愉快。

joy.en: She felt great joy after finishing the difficult project successfully.
joy.zh: 她成功完成困難的專題後感到非常喜悅。

joyous.en: The graduation ceremony was a joyous occasion for students and families.
joyous.zh: 畢業典禮對學生與家人而言是個歡樂的時刻。

judgement.en: Good judgement helps people make careful choices under pressure.
judgement.zh: 良好的判斷力能幫助人在壓力下做出謹慎選擇。

judicial.en: The article explains the judicial process in simple terms.
judicial.zh: 這篇文章用簡單方式說明司法程序。

jug.en: She filled a glass jug with cold water for the table.
jug.zh: 她把一只玻璃壺裝滿冷水放在桌上。

juicy.en: The peach was sweet and juicy after ripening for several days.
juicy.zh: 那顆桃子熟了幾天後又甜又多汁。

jungle.en: The documentary showed colorful birds living deep in the jungle.
jungle.zh: 紀錄片拍到住在叢林深處的彩色鳥類。

junk.en: We removed old junk from the storage room before repainting it.
junk.zh: 重新粉刷儲藏室前，我們先清掉了舊雜物。

kangaroo.en: A kangaroo can travel quickly across wide areas of grassland.
kangaroo.zh: 袋鼠可以快速穿越廣大的草原地區。

keeper.en: The museum keeper checked each display before visitors arrived.
keeper.zh: 博物館管理員在訪客抵達前檢查每件展品。

ketchup.en: He added a little ketchup to his fries at lunch.
ketchup.zh: 他午餐時在薯條上加了一點番茄醬。

kettle.en: The kettle began to whistle when the water became hot.
kettle.zh: 水變熱時，水壺開始發出鳴聲。

mass.en: The experiment measured the mass of several objects in grams.
mass.zh: 實驗用公克測量數個物體的質量。

mate.en: Each student worked with a class mate during the activity.
mate.zh: 活動期間每位學生都和一位同學合作。

merchant.en: The old merchant sold cloth and spices at the market.
merchant.zh: 那位老商人在市場販售布料和香料。

mercy.en: The story shows a ruler choosing mercy instead of punishment.
mercy.zh: 故事描述一位統治者選擇仁慈而不是懲罰。

mere.en: A mere ten minutes of review improved her confidence before class.
mere.zh: 僅僅十分鐘的複習就提升了她上課前的信心。

merge.en: The two small clubs decided to merge into one larger group.
merge.zh: 兩個小社團決定合併成一個較大的團體。

merit.en: The proposal has merit because it solves several practical problems.
merit.zh: 這項提案有其優點，因為它解決了幾個實際問題。

mermaid.en: The children read a story about a mermaid near the sea.
mermaid.zh: 孩子們讀了一個關於海邊美人魚的故事。

merry.en: The room felt merry during the end-of-year celebration.
merry.zh: 年終慶祝活動時，整個房間充滿歡樂氣氛。

mess.en: Please clean the mess on the table before class begins.
mess.zh: 上課開始前，請把桌上的凌亂收拾乾淨。

messenger.en: A messenger delivered the document to the office before noon.
messenger.zh: 一名信使在中午前把文件送到辦公室。

messy.en: His desk became messy after several hours of project work.
messy.zh: 做了幾個小時的專題後，他的桌面變得很亂。

metal.en: The bridge uses strong metal beams to support its weight.
metal.zh: 這座橋使用堅固的金屬樑來支撐重量。

metaphor.en: The teacher explained how a metaphor can make writing more vivid.
metaphor.zh: 老師說明比喻如何讓文章更生動。

meter.en: The runner stopped after completing one hundred meter intervals.
meter.zh: 跑者完成數次一百公尺間歇後停下來休息。

metro.en: Many commuters use the metro to reach the city center.
metro.zh: 許多通勤族搭地鐵前往市中心。

metropolitan.en: The metropolitan area includes several cities and surrounding suburbs.
metropolitan.zh: 這個都會區包含數個城市與周邊郊區。

microphone.en: She tested the microphone before giving her presentation on stage.
microphone.zh: 她上台報告前先測試了麥克風。

microscope.en: Students used a microscope to examine tiny plant cells.
microscope.zh: 學生使用顯微鏡觀察微小的植物細胞。

microwave.en: The office has a microwave for heating lunch during breaks.
microwave.zh: 辦公室有一台微波爐供大家休息時加熱午餐。

midnight.en: The final train leaves shortly before midnight on weekdays.
midnight.zh: 平日末班車會在午夜前不久發車。

midst.en: She stayed calm in the midst of a busy school week.
midst.zh: 在忙碌的一週中，她仍保持冷靜。

mourn.en: People gathered to mourn the loss of an important community leader.
mourn.zh: 人們聚在一起悼念一位重要的社區領袖。

mournful.en: A mournful melody played quietly at the memorial event.
mournful.zh: 紀念活動中輕輕播放著一段哀傷的旋律。

muscle.en: Regular movement helps each muscle stay active and flexible.
muscle.zh: 規律活動有助於每塊肌肉保持活躍與靈活。

muscular.en: The biology chart shows how the muscular system supports movement.
muscular.zh: 生物圖表顯示肌肉系統如何支持身體活動。

mustache.en: The actor wore a fake mustache for the comedy scene.
mustache.zh: 那位演員在喜劇場景中戴了一撮假鬍子。

occupation.en: The form asks each adult to list an occupation.
occupation.zh: 這份表格要求每位成人填寫職業。

occurrence.en: Heavy rain is a common occurrence during the wet season.
occurrence.zh: 大雨在雨季是常見的現象。

octopus.en: An octopus can change color to blend with its surroundings.
octopus.zh: 章魚可以改變顏色來融入周遭環境。

odor.en: A strange odor came from the old refrigerator in the kitchen.
odor.zh: 廚房裡的舊冰箱傳出一股奇怪氣味。

outlaw.en: The story follows an outlaw hiding in a remote mountain town.
outlaw.zh: 故事描述一名逃犯法外之徒躲在偏遠山城。

pharmacist.en: The pharmacist explained the label information in a clear way.
pharmacist.zh: 藥師清楚說明了標籤上的資訊。

pharmacy.en: The hospital pharmacy stores medicines under controlled conditions.
pharmacy.zh: 醫院藥局在受控條件下保存藥品。

policeman.en: A policeman directed traffic near the school during the event.
policeman.zh: 活動期間，一名警察在學校附近指揮交通。

political.en: The class compared several political systems from a historical perspective.
political.zh: 全班從歷史角度比較了幾種政治制度。
